title: Native Rust toolchain rebuild
summary: Opt-in x86-64 rebuild with the hosted compiler and Cargo. The no-op replay preserves every target file and SHA-256. Only the mtimes of x86_64-breenix/selfhost/{,lib}<tool>.d for bas, bld, bar, bnm, bcc and bmake may change (E25 ruling 137).
